copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 它把 Discord 适配器复制进项目并注册、安装适配器依赖、构建并跑注册测试；再引导你创建机器人、粘贴 Bot Token，自动导出凭据写入 .env、重启服务并打通私聊。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 添加 Discord 机器人通道时接管；它属于 /setup 流程的一环，装完后可用 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 接线。

say.text: 帮我加上 Discord 通道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 这是我的 Discord Bot Token：xxxx
把 Discord 机器人拉进我的服务器，并打通私聊
say.note: 会给出邀请链接并解析私聊频道

howto.what_en: It copies the Discord adapter into the project, registers it, installs the package, builds and runs the registration test; then it guides bot creation, stores the Bot Token and derived credentials in .env, and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw; it is part of the /setup flow, and afterwards you wire the channel with /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add a Discord channel to this project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the package and runs the registration test.

say_en.text: Here is my Discord Bot Token: ...
say_en.note: Validates it, then derives the Application ID and Public Key.

say_en.text: Invite the Discord bot to my server and set up our DM.
say_en.note: Gives the invite URL and resolves the DM channel.
